import pickle
from surprise import Dataset, Reader, SVD
from surprise.model_selection import train_test_split
from surprise.accuracy import rmse

reader = Reader(line_format='user item rating timestamp', sep=',', skip_lines=1, rating_scale=(1,5))
data = Dataset.load_from_file('/app/ratings.csv', reader)
trainset, testset = train_test_split(data, test_size=0.2, random_state=42)
algo = SVD(n_factors=50, n_epochs=30, lr_all=0.005, reg_all=0.02, random_state=42)
algo.fit(trainset)
preds = algo.test(testset)
print('RMSE:', rmse(preds))
with open('/app/model.pkl','wb') as f:
    pickle.dump(algo, f)
EOF
